title: transform.quest_logged v1
description: A Transform quest logged in child view for the child's day: the count is kept in transform (kid_quests), published in the same transaction as the log. children gives the quest's star the first time and marks Transform done in child view. Schema of the event's payload; the envelope (ids, location, version) is checked by common.events. Changes are additive only: new fields are optional (7.8).

quest.description: The quest's index in the interest.
